adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Restored on Titan, Quill steps through the portal Stephen Strange opens to Earth and joins the battle against Thanos's army.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer whose portal takes Quill from Titan to the battle.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Strange brings from Titan to the battle.
adds.evidence: After the Blip is undone, Strange enlists the restored Guardians and Spider-Man on Titan and opens a portal that brings them to the ruins of the Avengers Compound for the Battle of Earth.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Thor joins the Guardians aboard the Benatar, and Quill reminds him that it is still his ship and he is in charge. Thor agrees, and they laugh off the idea of fighting for the lead.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Quill's Guardians, and agrees Quill is in charge.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Guardian who tells Thor the ship is still his.
adds.evidence: Quill picks Thor up at New Asgard; on the Benatar he moves Thor's hand off the map and says 'this is my ship still. I'm in charge', Thor answers 'Of course you are', and the team's suggestion they fight for leadership is laughed off.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Wong brings the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj and allies from across the universe through portals to fight Thanos's army. When Strange asks if that is everyone, Wong asks whether he wanted more.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Brings the sorcerers to the battle beside Strange.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend who asks Wong if that is everyone.
adds.evidence: At the Battle of Earth, Strange meets Wong after the portals open: 'Is that everyone?' 'What, you wanted more?' They later stand side by side at Tony's funeral.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: T'Challa leads Wakanda's armies through a portal to the ruined Avengers Compound, sharing a look with a battered Steve Rogers, then joins the charge Steve leads against Thanos's army.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wakanda's king, whose arrival through a portal relieves Steve.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The battered leader T'Challa joins in the charge against Thanos.
adds.evidence: T'Challa, Shuri and Okoye walk out of a portal; he shares a glance with a battle-weary Steve, who shows relief, and T'Challa joins the charge after Steve rallies everyone.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: As T'Challa runs with the gauntlet, Thanos charges at him, and Wanda blocks his path and takes Thanos on so T'Challa can get away.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The witch who blocks Thanos's charge at T'Challa.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The king Wanda saves from Thanos's charge.
adds.evidence: Barton passes the gauntlet to Black Panther; as Thanos prepares to charge at T'Challa, his path is blocked by Wanda, who engages Thanos while T'Challa runs.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: Thor joins Quill's Guardians and they spar over who leads. Ally (now teammates) or keep rival (the leadership contest from Infinity War continues)?
owner_calls.evidence: Benatar scene: Quill insists 'this is my ship still. I'm in charge'; Thor concedes; next stage is friend in Thor: Love and Thunder.
